title: Analyzing the Spread and Transformation of Quantum Information in Large Quantum Systems under External Control
content: In this paper, we analyze the propagation and transmission of quantum information in large quantum systems under external control. Using the entanglement entropy growth rate analysis, and employing several tools such as Fourier analysis, Hamiltonian quantization, and out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs), we attempt to arrive at a formula that provides a deeper understanding of the mechanisms of quantum information propagation.
